text:
elaine: Heads up 1: design question for the roles grid. If org-level SSO is turned on, do we show an inline 'SSO enforced' indicator per role, or keep it only in the org banner and a global setting? Thinking about users who land directly on Roles.
kevin: I'd vote inline. People scan rows not banners. A small lock + 'SSO' chip next to the role label keeps the affordance local.
sam: Inline is fine but needs to be accessible. Chip must be reachable via keyboard, have aria-describedby for the tooltip, and not rely on color. Also read order: when tabbing into a row, screen reader should announce the SSO state before the role name.
anita: Compliance ask: if SSO is required for some roles only, that needs to show up clearly in exportable CSVs and in audit filters. Can we add a column export flag?
maria: Mobile density concern: rows already wrap. If chip shows for every role it could push layout. Maybe show icon-only on <480px with accessible label.
kevin: Mock idea: 10px lock icon + subtle border, tooltip on hover/focus with text: 'SSO required for this role since May 2'. On hover we show timestamp + who enabled it.
elaine: Microcopy suggestion: change org toggle label from 'Enforce SSO' to 'Require SSO for members' 1: more explicit. Also for the chip use 'SSO required' (avoid 'Enforced' verb).
sam: For screen readers aria-label="SSO required for this role. Enabled by Alice on May 2." Keep it concise. Add role-level aria-pressed? probably not.
uxbot: uploaded: sso_chip_variants_v3.png (prototype link) :upload:
kevin: Audit access: roles page header could have a quick link 'Audit trail' that opens a right-hand panel pre-filtered to role-related events. That way admins don't have to go to Settings > Security.
anita: +1. Compliance needs default columns: actor_id, event_type, timestamp, ip, resource_id, previous_value, new_value. Also retention note: show policy banner if user lacks permission to view full IPs.
maria: UX nit: if quicklink opens panel, include small last-modified date and a mini search. Keyboard shortcut request: press '?' to open keyboard help and 'g' then 'u' to open audit.
sam: Important: panel must not trap focus. Use focus trap only for modals; side panel should be non-modal with accessible skip link. Restore focus to the Audit quicklink after closing.
kevin: For tiny screens collapse the chip to icon-only and show the full text in the panel or role details drawer.
elaine: Next steps: @kevin produce two Figma variants (chip full vs icon-only) and share links; @sam write the ARIA/focus behavior and keyboard map; @anita confirm export/audit column contract and retention banner language; @maria test the mobile wrap scenarios on iPhone SE and Android narrow. I'll host a 20m design review at 3pm tomorrow.
kevin: Will post Figma links by 6pm PST.
sam: Will draft ARIA spec + keyboard map today and drop in this thread.
anita: I'll sync with compliance and drop the required columns and banner copy here by noon.
maria: I'll run quick mobile QA and report any row-overflow issues.
uxbot: prototype scheduled: 1768402150. Interactive flows for narrow breakpoints will be available.
elaine: Thanks all :thumbsup: web4ll iterate after the review.
